Overview

This feature service provides civic address point information for Westbank First Nation in British Columbia. It supports location-based addressing, emergency response, navigation, and community mapping workflows.

Feature Layer

  • WFN Address Points: A point layer representing address locations and related address components for the Westbank First Nation community. The layer includes core addressing details such as civic numbers, street name elements, postal information, community references, placement method, and geographic coordinates.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia, Canada.

Use Cases

  • Community and civic address mapping
  • Geocoding and address lookup
  • Emergency service routing and response support
  • Planning, asset management, and local operations

Source and Access

The data is maintianed by Westbank First Nation and provided by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, along with the published disclaimer and terms of use.
